text:
alex: Hey team — I accepted the org invite but I can only see a few public repos. Trying to access redwood/private-sample and it's showing me as an \"outside collaborator\". Also getting a 2FA setup prompt I haven't completed. Is there a step I'm missing?

onboarding-bot: Welcome @alex :tada: Quick checklist: 1) Confirm you accepted the invite using the same GitHub account you used for signup. 2) Complete SSO if your org requires SSO. 3) Enable 2FA (required). See https://redwood.example.com/onboarding/github-access

alex: I accepted with the same account (personal+work mixed a bit). How do I check SSO status?

jamie: @alex — if you go to Settings -> Organizations on GitHub it will show if you're pending SSO. Also check your email for a separate SSO button after accepting the invite. If you're prompted for 2FA, you can use an auth app or security key.

ben: Also check whether you have multiple GitHub sessions in the browser. We often see the org invite accepted on one account while you're signed into another. Try this flow:

```
1. Sign out of github.com
2. Sign back in with the account you used for the invite
3. Go to https://github.com/orgs/redwood-inference/invitation
4. Accept SSO if prompted
```

sreena: Adding — if you still show as outside collaborator ping me and I'll re-add you to the team manually. Sometimes SSO mapping to org teams fails and a manual team invite fixes it. If you want, paste the exact GitHub username here (no @).

alex: thanks — username is alex-w. I tried signing out & back in, accepted SSO, enabled 2FA with Authy. Still says outside collaborator on redwood/private-sample, can't open issues.

jamie: @sreena can you check membership mapping for alex-w?

sreena: checking... I see the account in the org but not assigned to eng-onboarding team. I can send a team invite now.

sreena: invited alex-w to team eng-onboarding — should be email or GitHub notification. After you accept the team invite you should get repo perms.

alex: got the team invite, accepted. Repo access looks good now, can open issues. Thanks everyone! :rocket:

ben: If anything odd crops up, clear the browser cookies for github.com (or try an incognito window) — stale session tokens are the usual culprit.

onboarding-bot: Marking thread resolved after team membership confirmed. If you hit permissions again open a new thread in #help or ping @sreena.
